# Talk Deck Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A 27-slide reveal.js deck under `slides/`, styled from the OSFF template, with real terminal output regenerated by a script, CALM Hub screenshots of the model, speaker notes on every slide, published at `/agentic-sdlc-blueprint/slides/` by the existing docs workflow and presentable offline from disk.

**Architecture:** One `index.html` holds the 27 `<section>` slides and their `<aside class="notes">`. A small inline script fills terminal panes from `captures.js` (generated by `capture.sh`, which replays the lab commands in a throwaway worktree the way `labs/verify.sh` does) and stamps the five-station ring onto every content slide from a `data-station` attribute. reveal.js is vendored, unmodified, under `slides/vendor/reveal/`. `slides/check.mjs` is the deck's test: it parses `index.html` and `captures.js` and fails on any structural defect.

**Tech Stack:** reveal.js 6.0.2 (MIT, vendored), plain HTML/CSS/JS, bash, Node 22+ for the scripts, Playwright from the neighbouring `architecture-as-code` checkout for screenshots only.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-21-talk-deck-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- No em-dashes anywhere: slides, notes, scripts, commit messages. Use commas, colons or full stops.
- Nothing in `slides/` is needed to run the labs. Attendee setup stays Node 22+, git, `npm install`.
- `gates/` is not touched. The only control plane file this plan modifies is `.github/workflows/docs.yml`.
- Every claim on a slide is something the labs do. If a slide needs something the labs do not say, stop and raise it; do not change the labs inside this plan.
- Conventional, small commits. No `Spec:` trailer applies (no code under `services/` or `test/` changes). No Claude co-author trailer.
- Template palette and type: Arial; text `#212121`, secondary `#595959`, blue `#4285F4`, amber `#FFAB40`, teal `#0097A7`; 16:9.
- Commit messages and file text in British English, as the repository uses.

**Files:**
- Create: `slides/index.html`, `slides/deck.css`, `slides/check.mjs`, `slides/img/background.png`, `slides/img/logo.svg`, `slides/vendor/reveal/**`, `slides/.gitignore`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `slides/check.mjs` (run with `node slides/check.mjs`, exit 0 on a valid deck), the `<section>` conventions every later task follows: `class="title"`, `class="section-slide"`, or a content slide with `data-station="model|spec|agent|gate|evidence|none"`; every section contains `<aside class="notes">` starting with `Speaker: Aaron` or `Speaker: Matthew`; terminal panes are `<pre class="term" data-capture="KEY"></pre>`; `HUB_LINKS` is a JS object in `index.html` with keys `architecture`, `pattern`, `controls`, `site`, `repo`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing check**

Create `slides/check.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// The deck's test. Parses index.html and captures.js and fails on structural defects.
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const dir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const html = readFileSync(join(dir, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const problems = [];

const sections = html.match(/<section\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/section>/g) ?? [];
const expected = Number(process.env.EXPECTED_SLIDES ?? 27);
if (sections.length !== expected) problems.push(`expected ${expected} slides, found ${sections.length}`);

sections.forEach((s, i) => {
  const n = i + 1;
  const notes = s.match(/<aside class="notes">([\s\S]*?)<\/aside>/);
  if (!notes) problems.push(`slide ${n}: no speaker notes`);
  else if (!/^\s*Speaker: (Aaron|Matthew)\b/.test(notes[1])) problems.push(`slide ${n}: notes must start with "Speaker: Aaron" or "Speaker: Matthew"`);
  const isTitle = /class="title"/.test(s.split('>')[0]);
  const isSection = /class="section-slide"/.test(s.split('>')[0]);
  const station = s.split('>')[0].match(/data-station="(model|spec|agent|gate|evidence|none)"/);
  if (!isTitle && !isSection && !station) problems.push(`slide ${n}: content slide needs data-station`);
});

if (/\u2014/.test(html)) problems.push('index.html contains an em-dash');

const keys = [...html.matchAll(/data-capture="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
if (keys.length) {
  const capturesPath = join(dir, 'captures.js');
  if (!existsSync(capturesPath)) problems.push('captures.js missing; run slides/capture.sh');
  else {
    const captures = {};
    const fn = new Function('window', readFileSync(capturesPath, 'utf8'));
    fn({ CAPTURES: captures, set CAPTURES(v) { Object.assign(captures, v); } });
    for (const k of new Set(keys)) if (!(k in captures)) problems.push(`capture "${k}" is referenced but not in captures.js`);
  }
}

for (const p of problems) console.error(`check: ${p}`);
console.log(problems.length ? `check: ${problems.length} problem(s)` : `check: ok, ${sections.length} slides`);
process.exit(problems.length ? 1 : 0);
```

```css
/* Styling derived from the OSFF New York 2026 template: Arial, its theme palette, its blue network background. */
:root {
  --ink: #212121; --muted: #595959; --blue: #4285F4; --amber: #FFAB40; --teal: #0097A7; --paper: #ffffff; --term: #212121;
}
.reveal { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); font-size: 36px; }
.reveal .slides section { text-align: left; padding: 0 120px; box-sizing: border-box; height: 100%; }
.reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3 { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; margin: 0 0 0.4em; }
.reveal h1 { font-size: 104px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.reveal h2 { font-size: 72px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; }
.reveal h3 { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; }
.reveal p, .reveal li { font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.4; }
.reveal ul { margin: 0 0 0 1em; }
.reveal li { margin: 0.25em 0; }
.reveal a { color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; }
.reveal .muted { color: var(--muted); }
.reveal .amber { color: var(--amber); }
.reveal .teal { color: var(--teal); }
.reveal small, .reveal .small { font-size: 26px; }

/* Title and section slides: the template's blue network background, white text, white logo. */
.reveal section.title, .reveal section.section-slide { color: #fff; }
.reveal section.title h1, .reveal section.section-slide h2, .reveal section.title p, .reveal section.section-slide p { color: #fff; }
.reveal section.title .logo, .reveal section.section-slide .logo { position: absolute; left: 130px; top: 220px; width: 740px; }
.reveal section.title .block { position: absolute; left: 960px; top: 240px; width: 880px; }
.reveal section.title .block p { font-size: 44px; margin-top: 1em; }
.reveal section.section-slide h2 { position: absolute; left: 120px; top: 440px; width: 1680px; }
.reveal section.section-slide p { position: absolute; left: 120px; top: 620px; width: 1680px; font-size: 44px; }

/* Content slides: white, small logo top left as the template places it, title top, station ring bottom right. */
.reveal section.content { background: var(--paper); padding-top: 150px; }
.reveal section.content .corner-logo { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; width: 130px; height: 120px; background: var(--blue); border-radius: 0 0 12px 0; padding: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; }
.reveal section.content .corner-logo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.reveal section.content h2 { font-size: 60px; }
.reveal .cols { display: flex; gap: 60px; align-items: flex-start; }
.reveal .cols > * { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }
.reveal .cols > .wide { flex: 1.6 1 0; }

/* Terminal panes: real output, dark, coloured by deck.js at load. */
.reveal pre.term { font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.35; background: var(--term); color: #e6e6e6; padding: 28px 32px; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: none; margin: 0.4em 0; white-space: pre-wrap; max-height: 720px; overflow: hidden; }
.reveal pre.term .pass, .reveal pre.term .ok { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 700; }
.reveal pre.term .fail, .reveal pre.term .bad { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }
.reveal pre.term .dim { color: #9a9a9a; }
.reveal pre.term.missing { border: 4px solid var(--amber); }
.reveal pre.code { font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.35; background: #f4f5f7; color: var(--ink); padding: 28px 32px; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: none; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.reveal .live { display: inline-block; font-size: 24px; color: var(--amber); border: 3px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 18px; margin-left: 16px; vertical-align: middle; }

/* The five-station ring: the one repeated motif. */
.reveal .ring { position: absolute; right: 40px; bottom: 30px; width: 300px; height: 90px; }
.reveal .ring text { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; fill: var(--muted); }
.reveal .ring circle { fill: #d9dbe1; }
.reveal .ring .on circle { fill: var(--blue); }
.reveal .ring .on text { fill: var(--blue); font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .ring line { stroke: #d9dbe1; stroke-width: 3; }

/* Big statements */
.reveal .statement { font-size: 64px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0.4em; }
.reveal table { font-size: 30px; border-collapse: collapse; }
.reveal table th, .reveal table td { padding: 10px 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid #e3e5ea; text-align: left; }
.reveal table th { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: 10px 36px; font-size: 32px; }
.reveal .kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
.reveal .kv dd { margin: 0; }
.reveal .hub-shot { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<body>
<div class="reveal">
  <div class="slides">

    <section class="title" data-background-image="img/background.png" data-background-size="cover">
      <img class="logo" src="img/logo.svg" alt="Open Source in Finance Forum">
      <div class="block">
        <h1>Governing the Agentic SDLC</h1>
        <p>Driving agentic development with FINOS CALM<br><span class="small">Matthew Bain and Aaron Searle<br>OSFF New York, 4 November 2026</span></p>
      </div>
      <aside class="notes">Speaker: Aaron. Welcome. Two of us: Aaron on the controls catalog and the contribution path, Matthew on CALM and the blueprint you can clone. Thirty five minutes, questions at the end.</aside>
    </section>

  </div>
</div>

<script src="vendor/reveal/dist/reveal.js"></script>
<script src="vendor/reveal/plugin/notes/notes.js"></script>
<script src="captures.js"></script>
<script>
// Links to the published artefacts. Point at the FINOS-hosted CALM Hub once the seeding PR lands; nothing else changes.
const HUB_LINKS = {
  repo: 'https://github.com/rocketstack-matt/agentic-sdlc-blueprint',
  site: 'https://rocketstack-matt.github.io/agentic-sdlc-blueprint/',
  architecture: 'https://rocketstack-matt.github.io/agentic-sdlc-blueprint/trade-capture.architecture.json',
  pattern: 'https://rocketstack-matt.github.io/agentic-sdlc-blueprint/patterns/governed-service.pattern.json',
  controls: 'https://rocketstack-matt.github.io/agentic-sdlc-blueprint/controls/',
};

// Fill terminal panes from captures.js and colour the words that matter.
const colour = (text) => text
  .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
  .replace(/^(PASS)\b/gm, '<span class="pass">$1</span>')
  .replace(/^(FAIL)\b/gm, '<span class="fail">$1</span>')
  .replace(/\b(ADMISSIBLE|ok \d+|# pass \d+|Errors: no)/g, '<span class="ok">$1</span>')
  .replace(/\b(BLOCKED|ERROR|DRIFT:|CONTROL BREACH:|UNDECLARED MODEL CHANGE:|UNMODELLED BINDING:|Errors: yes)/g, '<span class="bad">$1</span>')
  .replace(/\b(WARN|INFO)\b/g, '<span class="dim">$1</span>');
for (const pre of document.querySelectorAll('pre.term[data-capture]')) {
  const key = pre.dataset.capture;
  const text = window.CAPTURES?.[key];
  if (text === undefined) { pre.classList.add('missing'); pre.textContent = `capture missing: ${key}. Run slides/capture.sh`; }
  else pre.innerHTML = colour(text.trimEnd());
}

// Stamp the corner logo and the five-station ring onto every content slide.
const STATIONS = ['model', 'spec', 'agent', 'gate', 'evidence'];
for (const s of document.querySelectorAll('section[data-station]')) {
  s.classList.add('content');
  s.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<div class="corner-logo"><img src="img/logo.svg" alt=""></div>');
  const on = s.dataset.station;
  const nodes = STATIONS.map((name, i) => `<g class="${name === on ? 'on' : ''}"><circle cx="${30 + i * 60}" cy="30" r="12"/><text x="${30 + i * 60}" y="70" text-anchor="middle">${name}</text></g>`).join('');
  s.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<svg class="ring" viewBox="0 0 300 90" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="30" y1="30" x2="270" y2="30"/>${nodes}</svg>`);
}
for (const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[data-hub]')) { a.href = HUB_LINKS[a.dataset.hub]; if (!a.textContent.trim()) a.textContent = a.href; }

Reveal.initialize({ hash: true, width: 1920, height: 1080, margin: 0.04, minScale: 0.2, maxScale: 2, controls: false, progress: false, slideNumber: 'c/t', transition: 'none', plugins: [RevealNotes] });
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `slides/capture.sh`**

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regenerates slides/captures.js by replaying the lab commands in a throwaway worktree, the same way labs/verify.sh
# does, so every terminal pane in the deck shows what the repository does today. Usage: bash slides/capture.sh
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
OUT="$ROOT/slides/captures.js"
cd "$ROOT"
[ -d node_modules ] || { echo "run npm install first"; exit 2; }
unset BASE_REF SPEC PR_BODY CHANGE_AUTHOR_KIND CHANGE_AUTHOR_ID
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=lab-runner GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=lab-runner@example.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=lab-runner GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=lab-runner@example.invalid NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1

WT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/blueprint-capture.XXXXXX")
cleanup() { cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$WT"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git worktree add --detach -q "$WT" HEAD
ln -s "$ROOT/node_modules" "$WT/node_modules"
cd "$WT"

TMP=$(mktemp)
echo "// Generated by slides/capture.sh on $(date -u +%FT%TZ). Do not edit." > "$TMP"
echo "window.CAPTURES = {};" >> "$TMP"
cap() {                       # cap KEY "<command>"   records stdout+stderr, minus npm's own banner lines
  local key=$1; shift
  echo "\$ $*"
  local out; out=$(bash -c "$*" 2>&1 | grep -vE '^(> |$)' || true)
  node -e 'const [k,v]=process.argv.slice(1);process.stdout.write(`window.CAPTURES[${JSON.stringify(k)}] = ${JSON.stringify(v)};\n`)' "$key" "$out" >> "$TMP"
}
strip() { sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'; }

cap clean-gates "npm run gates"
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='architecture/trade-capture.architecture.json';const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));delete a.nodes.find(n=>n['unique-id']==='trade-api').metadata['source-path'];fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(a,null,2)+'\n')"
cap lab1-break-pattern "npm run calm:validate 2>&1 | grep -vE '^\S*info' | sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'"
git checkout -q architecture/
cap context "npm run calm:context -- --spec SPEC-001 2>&1 | node -e \"let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s.slice(s.indexOf('{')));const t=j.scope[0];console.log(JSON.stringify({node:t.node.id,mayConnectTo:t.mayConnectTo.map(m=>m.node),mustNotConnectTo:t.mustNotConnectTo,rule:j.rule},null,2))})\""

git apply labs/patches/attempt-a-shortcut.patch
cap attempt-a-tests "npm test 2>&1 | grep -E '^(ok|not ok|# (tests|pass|fail))'"
cap attempt-a-gates "SPEC=SPEC-001 npm run gates"
git checkout -q -- . && git clean -fdq services test

git apply labs/patches/attempt-b-conformant.patch
cap attempt-b-gates "SPEC=SPEC-001 npm run gates"
cap review-cognitive "npm run gate:review"
echo "// reviewed" >> services/position-service/src/app.ts
cap review-human "npm run gate:review"
git checkout -q -- services/position-service/src/app.ts
git checkout -q -- . && git clean -fdq services test

git apply labs/patches/attempt-c-edit-the-model.patch
cap attempt-c-gates "SPEC=SPEC-001 npm run gates"
git checkout -q -- . && git clean -fdq services test specs

git apply labs/patches/spec-002-model-change.patch
cap spec-002-model "SPEC=SPEC-002 npm run gates"
git apply labs/patches/attempt-d-spec-002.patch
cap spec-002-impl "SPEC=SPEC-002 npm run gates"
git checkout -q -- . && git clean -fdq services test specs

git apply labs/patches/attempt-b-conformant.patch
git add -A && git commit -q -m "Add account summary endpoint" -m "Spec: SPEC-001"
cap evidence "CHANGE_AUTHOR_KIND=agent CHANGE_AUTHOR_ID=my-coding-agent npm run evidence"
BUNDLE=$(ls evidence/out/*.json | head -1)
cap evidence-json "node -e \"const b=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$BUNDLE'));const g=b.gates.map(x=>({gate:x.gate,passed:x.passed,controls:x.controls}));console.log(JSON.stringify({schema:b.schema,subject:{commit:b.subject.commit.slice(0,12)+'...',spec:b.subject.spec,architectureSha256:b.subject.architectureSha256.slice(0,16)+'...',changedFiles:b.subject.changedFiles},author:b.author,admissible:b.admissible,review:{requiredMode:b.review.requiredMode,authorMayNotReview:b.review.authorMayNotReview},controls:b.controls,gates:g,sha256:b.sha256.slice(0,16)+'...'},null,2))\""

mv "$TMP" "$OUT"
echo "wrote $OUT ($(grep -c 'window.CAPTURES\[' "$OUT") captures)"
```

### Task 7: CALM Hub screenshots of the model

**Files:**
- Create: `slides/hub-screenshots.sh`, `slides/hub-screenshot.mjs`, `slides/img/hub-model.png`, `slides/img/hub-position-store.png`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `architecture-as-code` checkout at `../architecture-as-code` with its `node_modules/playwright` and a built hub UI; the calm CLI in this repo's `node_modules`.
- Produces: the two PNGs slide 8 uses. The namespace `finos.agentic-sdlc` and slugs `trade-capture` (architecture) and `governed-service` (pattern) at version `1.0.0`, which the FINOS seeding PR will reuse.

- [ ] **Step 1: Start the local hub in standalone mode, in a separate terminal or background**

```bash
cd ../architecture-as-code/calm-hub && ../mvnw quarkus:dev -Pstandalone
```

Wait until `curl -sf http://localhost:8080/q/swagger-ui >/dev/null` succeeds (up to two minutes on first start).

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `slides/hub-screenshots.sh`**

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pushes copies of the model, the pattern and the control requirements to a local CALM Hub and screenshots the model.
# Needs a hub on http://localhost:8080 (see slides/README.md) and the architecture-as-code checkout next to this repo
# for Playwright. Usage: bash slides/hub-screenshots.sh
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
HUB=${CALM_HUB_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
NS=finos.agentic-sdlc
cd "$ROOT"
curl -sf "$HUB/q/swagger-ui" >/dev/null || { echo "no CALM Hub at $HUB"; exit 2; }

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
# The CLI needs a full document id. Copies get one; the repository's files do not change.
node -e '
const fs=require("fs");const [tmp,hub,ns]=process.argv.slice(1);
const withId=(file,id)=>{const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));d["$id"]=id;const out=`${tmp}/${file.split("/").pop()}`;fs.writeFileSync(out,JSON.stringify(d,null,2));return out;};
console.log(withId("architecture/trade-capture.architecture.json",`${hub}/calm/namespaces/${ns}/architectures/trade-capture/versions/1.0.0`));
console.log(withId("architecture/governed-service.pattern.json",`${hub}/calm/namespaces/${ns}/patterns/governed-service/versions/1.0.0`));
' "$TMP" "$HUB" "$NS"

npx --no-install calm hub create namespace --name "$NS" --description "Agentic SDLC blueprint: governed trade capture" -c "$HUB" -f pretty || true
npx --no-install calm hub push pattern "$TMP/governed-service.pattern.json" -c "$HUB" -f pretty
npx --no-install calm hub push architecture "$TMP/trade-capture.architecture.json" -c "$HUB" -f pretty
npx --no-install calm hub list architectures --namespace "$NS" -c "$HUB" -f pretty

NODE_PATH="$ROOT/../architecture-as-code/node_modules" node slides/hub-screenshot.mjs "$HUB" "$NS"
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `slides/hub-screenshot.mjs`**

```js
// Screenshots the pushed architecture in CALM Hub's UI at 2x. Playwright comes from the architecture-as-code checkout.
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const [hub, ns] = process.argv.slice(2);
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1400, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
await page.goto(`${hub}/${ns}/architectures/trade-capture/1.0.0`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
await page.screenshot({ path: 'slides/img/hub-model.png' });
const node = page.getByText('Position Store', { exact: false }).first();
if (await node.count()) { await node.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(800); await page.screenshot({ path: 'slides/img/hub-position-store.png' }); }
await browser.close();
console.log('wrote slides/img/hub-model.png' + (await node.count() ? ' and hub-position-store.png' : ' (position-store selection not found; retake by hand)'));
```

The hub UI's document route is `/:namespace/:type/:id/:version`. If the visualiser is elsewhere (for example `/visualizer`), open the hub in a browser, find the model's page, and change the `goto` URL; record the working URL in `slides/README.md`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Run it and look at the images**

Run: `bash slides/hub-screenshots.sh` then view both PNGs.
Expected: the whole model legible at slide size, node names readable. If the visualiser needs a manual layout or the graph is unreadable, stop, take the screenshot by hand after arranging the nodes, and note that in `slides/README.md`. If nothing usable comes out, use the fallback: replace slide 8's `<img>` with an inline SVG drawn from the model (six labelled boxes, five arrows, the same palette as slide 6) and say so in `slides/README.md`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Stop the hub, run the check, commit**

Run: `node slides/check.mjs` (expected `check: ok, 27 slides`).

```bash

git commit -m "feat(slides): CALM Hub screenshots of the model"
```

### Task 9: Visual QA of every slide

**Files:**
- Create: `slides/qa-screenshots.mjs` (output under `slides/qa/`, ignored by git)
- Modify: `slides/index.html`, `slides/deck.css`, `slides/capture.sh` as the findings require

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the screenshot script**

```js
// Screenshots every slide at 1920x1080 for visual review. Playwright comes from the architecture-as-code checkout.
// Run: NODE_PATH=../architecture-as-code/node_modules node slides/qa-screenshots.mjs
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
mkdirSync('slides/qa', { recursive: true });
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1920, height: 1080 } });
await page.goto('file://' + resolve('slides/index.html') + '?print-pdf', { waitUntil: 'load' });
await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
const total = await page.evaluate(() => Reveal.getTotalSlides());
await page.goto('file://' + resolve('slides/index.html'), { waitUntil: 'load' });
await page.waitForTimeout(800);
for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  await page.evaluate((n) => Reveal.slide(n), i);
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `slides/qa/slide-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.png` });
}
await browser.close();
console.log(`wrote ${total} screenshots to slides/qa/`);
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run it and read every screenshot**

Run: `NODE_PATH=../architecture-as-code/node_modules node slides/qa-screenshots.mjs`, then view each of the 27 PNGs. Check, in this order: text cut off or overflowing a pane or the slide; terminal panes clipped before their last line; low contrast; columns misaligned; the ring highlighting the wrong station; a broken image; leftover placeholder text. Fix each finding in `index.html`, `deck.css` or `capture.sh`, re-run `capture.sh` if the script changed, re-screenshot only the changed slides, and stop when the list is empty.

- [ ] **Step 3: Notes and offline check**

Open `slides/index.html` from disk with the network off, press `s`, step through all 27 slides in the speaker view. Expected: every slide has notes, the timer runs, no console errors.

```bash
git commit -m "fix(slides): visual QA pass"

```

## Self-review

- **Spec coverage.** Slides 1 to 27: Tasks 1 and 3 to 6. Visual design: Task 1 CSS. Files: Tasks 1, 2, 7, 8, 9. Captures with visible missing marker: Task 1 script, Task 2. Hub screenshots and fallback: Task 7. FINOS hub links in one place: `HUB_LINKS`, Task 1. Publishing and README link: Task 8. Testing (visual, captures, notes, published, offline): Tasks 2, 8, 9. Out of scope items untouched.
- **Placeholders.** None: every step carries its content. The one intentional gap is the hub UI route, which the plan tells the executor how to discover.
- **Type consistency.** `data-capture` keys in Tasks 4, 5, 6 all appear in the `cap` calls of Task 2. `HUB_LINKS` keys (`repo`, `site`, `architecture`, `pattern`, `controls`) match every `data-hub` attribute. Section conventions (`title`, `section-slide`, `data-station`) are the same in `check.mjs`, `deck.css` and every slide.
